## Goal

## Acceptance Criteria

- Provider override tests verify the resolved provider is not replaced by active/default profile settings.
- No workflow.publish special case is introduced.

## Implementation Notes

## Test Strategy
Unit tests call createPluginAgentApi with a stub or dry-run Agent path and assert the forwarded options and resolved provider precedence.
